title: 4.9 Days of the Week
unit_outcome: Talk about your home, where things are, your morning, what you do at home, the days, the time and the months in Spanish.
goal: Name the days of the week and say what day it is today.
grammar_function: ¿Qué día es hoy? Hoy es + day (lowercase).
speaking_outcome: Name the days of the week and say what day it is today.
